decision_to_unlock: Which professional service routes have enough current evidence for task matching, and which page claims or project terms need refresh before public buyer-facing edits?
finding: All ten professional_service destinations in SERVICE_ROUTE_REGISTRY were matched to a read-only official-page snapshot or search-index excerpt. Reported crawl age ranges from about one week to eight months; some direct reads return cache miss. These observations support route identity and limited page-level scope, but do not confirm live HTTP, forms, current commercial terms, delivery scope or project-specific rights.
evidence: Official page snapshots and index excerpts retrieved 2026-11-21
limitations: Crawl ages are approximate retrieval metadata, not exact source publication dates.
Cache misses are not HTTP 404 or proof of outage.
Current scope, prices, terms, rights and form workflows were not verified.
No GEO output, official website, profile, form or deployment was changed.
No search ranking, AI citation, referral, enquiry or conversion impact was measured.
next_decision: Use the refresh priorities in the evidence matrix before changing any service-specific public answer or contractual claim.
